name: TPV Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TPV Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and service of intelligent display terminal products in China and internationally. It offers monitors, TV, professional display, and sound products. The company sells its products under the AOC, AGON, Envision, Great Wall, and Philips brands. It serves the corporate, hospitality, education, transportation, retail, healthcare, public venues, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Nanjing Huadong Electronics Information & Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TPV Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2021. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Nanjing, China.
